eyebrow: Python Security Automation, SOAR & DevSecOps · Chapter 8
subtitle: Lesson 30 · Capstone: An Automated Detection-to-Response Pipeline

code:
- name: Dependency scan (pip-audit)
  run: pip-audit -r requirements.txt -f json -o pip-audit-report.json
  continue-on-error: true

- name: Static analysis (bandit)
  run: bandit -r src/ -f json -o bandit-report.json
  continue-on-error: true
caption: continue-on-error lets each scan finish and produce a report before any gate is applied.
Both scanners' findings, one threshold, applied in exactly one place.

steps.label: Block on Critical/High
steps.sub: a known-bad dependency or a real hard-coded secret

steps.label: Report, don't block, below that
steps.sub: visible in the PR, never silently ignored

steps.label: The payoff
steps.sub: a gate developers trust instead of learning to click past

code:
- name: Evaluate security gate
  run: python scripts/security_gate.py \
       --pip-audit pip-audit-report.json \
       --bandit bandit-report.json

- name: Upload scan reports
  if: always()
  uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: security-scan-reports
    path: |
      pip-audit-report.json
      bandit-report.json
caption: if: always() attaches the reports even when the gate step above fails and stops the job.
